test_title: SSC GD Constable Previous Year Paper (Held on: 15th December 2021 Shift 3)
subject: general
question:
The following sentence has been split into four segments. Identify the segment that contains a grammatical error.

Did you forgot / to post / the letter / that I gave you?
solution:
The correct answer is** "Did you forgot"**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **
**__Key Points__**

__
 
• The error lies in **Part(a)/option C **of the sentence.
 
• This is an interrogative sentence of simple past tense which is used to gather the information for the questions that have been asked.
 
 
• **Example:** Did you have a mobile phone when you are young?
 
 
 
• The correct answer to this question is "Did you forget to post the letter that I gave you?"

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• It uses the form Did+ sub+ V1+ object+(?).
 
• The Verb form of forget is:
 
• V1- forget, V2- forgot, V3- forgotten According to the simple past formula.​

​ **

 
 

 **Verb**
 **Form**
 **Example**
 
 

 **Forget**
 V1
 I forget things easily.
 
 

 **Forgot**
 V2
 I forgot to buy the chocolate you told me to.
 
 

 **Forgotten**
 V3
 I have forgotten most of the steps I learned from you.
 
 

1f
